{{Quote|Here. Put this on. It's a zerape. Local coloring out here in the Outer Rim worlds.|Reen Irana, to Mander Zuma|<ref name="Scourge (novel)">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>}}
A '''zerape''' was a poncho-like cloak that was commonly worn by residents of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]] to search for the missing [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera|Mika Anjiliac]]. On arrival on the world, Irana gave Zuma a zerape, so that he could blend in with the local inhabitants.

==Behind the scenes==
As described in [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], the zerape is similar to the real-world [[Wikipedia:serape|serape]] (sometimes spelled ''zarape'').
